newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen down on lack of market-boosting.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen down on lack of market-boosting.

text.p: Share prices on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to continue their downward trend on Thursday due to perceived government inaction on boosting the market, brokers said.
"Retail investors are gradually losing interest in the share market as the government is not taking steps to bolster the market," said Redwanul Islam of Dastagir Mohammad Adil & Company.

Brokers said the resignation of the chief of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), the market watchdog, might also affect the market. They said SEC chairman Harunur Rashid had taken a number of steps to revamp the market.
